headline: His versatility and ability to turn around compelling content quickly has earned him (and my team!) accolades
quote: You can never have too much content – the challenge is in finding talented writers that understand the business and (more importantly) the customer. Ben joined our team to support a broad array of content needs. His versatility and ability to turn around compelling content quickly has earned him (and my team!) accolades internally at Zeta.
name: Charlie Pendleton
role: Group Vice President, Product Marketing, Zeta Global
